tasks.description:
Create orchestrator/health_monitor.py — deterministic tripwire processor. Subscribes to EventBus events and evaluates five rules:
1. Heartbeat timeout → auto-nudge via message bus
2. Container exit → immediate HITL escalation
3. Repeated identical errors → escalate to overseer (or HITL if no overseer)
4. Message volume spike → auto-throttle
5. Progress stall → nudge, then escalate to overseer if unresolved
Uses PipelineConfig thresholds. Escalation sends structured context via message bus.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Each tripwire rule fires correctly at configured threshold; auto-nudge sends message via message bus; escalation messages include structured context (anomaly type, agent role, progress events)

tasks.acceptance_criteria: Endpoint returns active alerts with anomaly type, affected agent, and timestamp; CLI command formats output correctly

tasks.description:
Create orchestrator/overseer/ package with classification and decision-making:
classifier.py — Haiku functions: classify_stall(), classify_error(), detect_loop(), check_alignment(). Uses run_agent_async(model="haiku", max_turns=1). Caches results.
decision_maker.py — Sonnet/Opus functions: decide_corrective_action(), compose_redirect_message(), decide_escalation_level(). Uses run_agent_async(model=config_model, max_turns=1).
issue_filer.py — file_diagnostic_issue() using structured template, auto-labels overseer-alert + category. High-confidence autonomous, low-confidence HITL.
self_monitor.py — track poll timing, message volume, LLM costs. File issue and signal BLOCKED if malfunctioning.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All functions use shared/egg_agent/ exclusively (no direct API calls); classifier caches results; issue filer produces correct diagnostic template with labels; self-monitor detects threshold violations

tasks.description:
Create orchestrator/overseer/monitor.py — main monitoring loop:
Polls progress query and health alerts each cycle. Receives escalations from tripwire processor via message bus.
Routes to Haiku classifiers, then Sonnet/Opus for decisions. Executes corrective actions (redirect, HITL, issue, Slack).
Enforces hallucination guard: Sonnet/Opus only acts on received Haiku outputs.
Produces pipeline health summary at completion.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Monitor loop correctly routes escalations through Haiku → Sonnet/Opus pipeline; hallucination guard prevents acting on non-received data; health summary produced at pipeline end
